title: Welcome to the Demon List
author: Admin
excerpt: The Demon List is officially live! Read about our goals, structure, and how to get involved.
content:
Welcome to the **Demon List** — a community-driven ranking of the hardest Geometry Dash levels.

Our goal is simple: maintain an accurate, transparent, and community-respected ranking of extreme demons and challenges.

## What We Offer

- **Main List** — The definitive ranking of extreme demons
- **Challenge List** — Dedicated rankings for skill-based challenges
- **Leaderboard** — Tracking top players and their completions
- **News** — Official updates from the list team

## How to Submit

Submissions are currently handled via our Discord server. Join the community and follow the submission guidelines pinned in the relevant channels.

We're excited to see your scores!
